fields.name: Handle
fields.description: Unique product identifier; multiple variant rows share the same Handle

constraints: One CSV row per variant — a product with 3 sizes has 3 rows, all sharing the same Handle
Prices are stored as plain numbers without a currency symbol
Inventory quantity can be negative when overselling is enabled
knownAbsences: There is NO 'Last Sold At', 'Last Sale Date', or 'Sales Last 90 Days' column in the standard Shopify product CSV export
There is NO sales history, order history, or revenue data in the product export
Dead stock detection based on sales dates requires a separate Shopify Orders export or the Analytics API — it cannot be derived from the product CSV alone
rawContext: Exported from Shopify Admin → Products → Export. Contains product and variant metadata only. To detect dead stock by last sale date, the tool should either accept a separate orders CSV as an additional input, warn the user that the data is unavailable, or treat any product with zero inventory as a proxy.
